experiment: D1/H4 derived from a genuinely longer H1 series (2025-01-01..2026-09-15, extended backward via SSC_V1_0_1_G2_DEV_002's own WARMUP_CONTEXT_ONLY H1 history) and passed to the UNMODIFIED engine as the FULL closed-to-date series at each decision point (no TAIL_D1=40/TAIL_H4=80 bounded-window truncation, unlike the parent run). M15 decision population, session windows, and strategy rules are all unchanged from the parent run.

comparison_to_parent_run.parent_run_context_pass_rate: 53/305 = 17.4% (305-252 days passed HTF_BIAS_NOT_ALIGNED check, parent run with 40/80-bar D1/H4 tail windows)
comparison_to_parent_run.interpretation: The CONTEXT (D1/H4 bias-alignment) pass rate is essentially UNCHANGED by a ~7.7x longer D1/H4 warm-up (40/80 bounded bars -> full history back to 2025-01-01, confirmed by n_d1_bars=220 already on the first evaluated day vs the parent run's bounded 40). This rules OUT explanations C (timeframe derivation/data inadequacy) and D (adapter/replay mismatch via bounded tail windows) as material causes of the dominant HTF_BIAS_NOT_ALIGNED blocker.

new_bottleneck_identified: In both cycles, every day that reaches the H1_CONTROL_SHIFT stage (5 LONDON_NEWYORK, 4 ASIAN_LONDON, out of 314 evaluated) fails there -- zero days ever reach M15_REFINEMENT. The engine's H1_SHIFT_MAX_AGE_BARS=4 requires a control-shift zone created within the last 4 H1 bars at evaluation time; combined with the LOCATION-stage requirement (fresh H4 POI + H1 touch), this is a very tight joint condition. This is recorded as an observation for a future diagnostic, NOT as a proposal to loosen the 4-bar recency window -- no rule or threshold is changed by this record.

explanations_resolution.A_genuinely_selective: SUPPORTED by this run's evidence (stable low pass-rate at CONTEXT regardless of warm-up length; sharp narrowing at H1_CONTROL_SHIFT)
explanations_resolution.B_sample_insufficient: NOT RESOLVED by this run (M15 decision population unchanged, still ~314 days, single symbol; a genuinely larger M15 population was out of scope -- no additional EURUSD M15 history exists in this checkout beyond the HIST1Y window)
explanations_resolution.C_timeframe_derivation_inadequate: REJECTED by this run's evidence (CONTEXT pass-rate unchanged despite ~7.7x longer D1/H4 history)
explanations_resolution.D_adapter_replay_mismatch_bounded_window: REJECTED for the CONTEXT stage specifically by this run (removing the bounded-tail-window approximation did not change the dominant blocker's rate); NOT fully excluded for other stages (M15_REFINEMENT/GEOMETRY never reached, so untested there)
explanations_resolution.E_session_restriction: NOT_VERIFIED by this run (both cycles behave similarly; no cross-session-removed-population test performed)
explanations_resolution.F_not_verified: Residual: the new H1_CONTROL_SHIFT bottleneck itself is not yet decomposed further

verdict: HOLD_SAMPLE_REQUIRED (UNCHANGED from parent run) -- min_trade_count=30 not met (0 trades, both cycles). This diagnostic experiment resolves part of the open explanation set (rules out C/D for the CONTEXT stage) but does not change the verdict, the kill-policy thresholds, or any strategy rule. No freeze campaign is proposed.
